value: **Involvement**: Teachers engaged in collaborative design partnerships as an authentic professional learning practice, co-creating pedagogical interventions while transforming instructional perspectives and disciplinary agency. **Evidence**: "P-BPD activities sought to engage teachers with place-based data literacy to (a) develop their knowledge and capacity to facilitate data interactions between students and research garden sites, and (b) co-design CitSci protocols for the agriPV CitSci network."
